summary: Verified 2 security fixes (SEC-001 server-authoritative shipping, SEC-002 payment-proof by id) + open-redirect hardening + JWT hardening + full regression. Backend pytest: 18/18 passed (10 legacy + 8 new security tests). Frontend Playwright: open-redirect hardening confirmed on /login (?redirectTo=//evil.com lands on /account, ?redirectTo=/cart still works). Session persistence verified after JWT hardening (multiple /auth/me + admin approve succeeded). Admin approve of a submitted payment returned 200 success:true. All API sanity endpoints (health, products, product detail) return success:true.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001 fix is clean: resolveShippingCost() in checkout.service.ts is used in BOTH previewCheckout and createOrder; client shipping.cost is completely ignored. Rates come from getShippingProvider().getRates() so table stays server-side. Invalid courier/service → HttpError 400 'Metode pengiriman tidak valid'. Verified end-to-end with a manipulated cost:0 body — created order still shows shippingCost=20000 and total=subtotal+20000.

SEC-002 fix is clean: /api/v1/admin/payments/proof now takes ?id=<PaymentConfirmation.id>, looks up proofPath from DB, and requires PERMISSIONS.PAYMENT_READ. Old ?path=... returns 400 'id diperlukan'. Bogus id returns 404. Non-admin (customer session) returns 401/403. Verified valid id returns image/png bytes.
Open-redirect hardening in auth.actions.ts safeRedirect() correctly rejects '//evil.com' (protocol-relative) — verified UI redirects to /account. Normal /cart internal redirect still works.
JWT hardening (HS256 pin + iss/aud + fail-closed secret) does not break existing sessions — verified session persists across multiple /api/v1/auth/me calls and admin approve action succeeded.
Minor: /api/v1/admin/payments has no GET handler (returns HTML 404 from Next.js). Not a regression — admin UI uses server data fetch, not this API. Left as-is.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_gheverhan_api.py (cart test: iterate variants to skip stock-depleted)
